github_branch_protection.note: Before production GO, attach evidence that main is protected with the required PR/check/force-push controls. Issue #91 remains the tracking gate until verified.

drive_launch_control_permissions.note: Before production GO, attach Drive permission metadata proving that anyone-with-link writer access has been removed from all 13 top-level Three Crowns project folders and current launch-control Docs/Sheets, with named-editor/read-only policy in place. Issue #100 remains the tracking gate until verified.

room_reconciliation.note: Physical room intake gate #38 is closed. On the real external staging database, run the approved importer dry-run, review the exact diff against the canonical 84-room / 12-category register, then record safe reconciliation evidence.

beget_host_preflight.note: Run non-destructive host/environment/network preflight on the actual authorized Beget target.

legacy_rollback_backup.note: Require archive/dump/uploads/config/DNS evidence, checksum and verified restore ownership for the currently live target.

external_https_wss_staging.note: Real isolated external staging must prove HTTPS, WSS, cookies, CORS, persistence, exact accepted SHA/image identity and private PostgreSQL.

external_public_truth_probe.note: Run the external public-truth probe against the real staging URL and retain output/evidence.

real_device_acceptance.note: Require real iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, desktop and Telegram/Staff/Kitchen acceptance.

provider_acceptance.note: If any messaging/AI provider is launch-enabled, set enabled=true and attach VERIFIED provider E2E, authenticity and idempotency evidence.

monitoring_alerting.note: Require real health/readiness, HTTP 5xx, container restart, DB/storage, TLS and backup-failure visibility with alert delivery evidence.

pre_cutover_backup.note: Fresh actual-target backup immediately before cutover with timestamp, checksum, off-site copy and restore owner.

dns_rollback_capture.note: Capture current DNS/TTL and exact rollback values before any production routing change.

owner_cutover_approval.note: Final production/DNS switch requires explicit owner approval only after all other required gates are VERIFIED.
